summary: National Healthcare Corporation (NHC) subsidiary NHC/OP, L.P. entered a Purchase and Sale Agreement to acquire 35 skilled nursing and independent living facilities from National Health Investors, Inc. (NHI) for $560 million cash, payable at close with no financing contingency. NHC expects to fund partly via a new credit facility. A $5M initial deposit is refundable until May 29, 2026 review period; after expiration, a $15M incremental deposit (total $20M) is non-refundable. NHI must post a matching $20M deposit payable as liquidated damages if NHC terminates post-review. The assets span seven states. Watch for regulatory approvals and financing terms; the refundable deposit structure offers a low-risk exit during diligence.
